rollups.text: The user’s houseplants and plant-care activities: planted a succulent on 2023-02-10, which had doubled in size by 2023-05-30; bought organic fertilizer from a local nursery on 2023-02-14 and was using it weekly on all plants by 2023-05-30; got an Aloe Vera plant on 2023-02-20 and was happy with it on 2023-05-30; repotted a Spider Plant on 2023-03-01, which had produced spiderettes by 2023-05-30; took Pothos cuttings on 2023-03-05 and was rooting them in water, with plans to pot them in soil by 2023-05-30.

The user’s aquariums and fish: on 2023-05-24, the user discussed betta fish Bubbles and an upgraded tank described as 10 gallons, which the assistant understood to be 20 gallons; on 2023-05-28, the user described a 20-gallon freshwater aquarium with 10 neon tetras, 5 golden honey gouramis, one small pleco catfish, artificial coral, and rocks. The user was considering Java moss, Anacharis, a treasure-chest decoration, and possibly lemon tetras or zebra danios; these additions were not confirmed.

The user’s photography equipment and related plans: while organizing gear during the weekend of 2023-05-13 to 2023-05-14, the user found a remote shutter release and extra batteries for an old Canon EOS 60D; on 2023-05-20, the user reported autofocus issues with a Sony A7III and native Sony E-mount 100–400mm lens, considered selling an unused old camera flash, and postponed buying a 50mm f/1.8 lens until more familiar with current gear. The user also planned to organize and edit Yellowstone photographs for Flickr.

The user reported intermittent autofocus failures indoors in dim light on a Sony A7III using Single-Shot AF and a native Sony E-mount 100–400mm lens on 2023-05-20. The user planned to try AF Micro Adjustment and AF Drive Speed settings, clean the lens and sensor, and install the latest firmware. The records do not confirm whether these steps were completed or whether autofocus improved.

The user planned a morning routine to make progress on a novel: on 2023-05-22, the user usually woke at 6:30 a.m. and planned to write for 30 minutes before getting ready for work; the user then decided to meditate immediately after waking before writing. No follow-up confirms whether the routine began.

The user reported that a bathroom sink had drained slowly for three weeks by 2023-05-22. Drain cleaner used twice, a plunger, and a plumbing snake tried on 2023-05-21 had not helped. The user suspected a very smelly bathroom trash can contributed to the odor. The user planned to clean the sink aerator, P-trap, and trash can over the coming weekend and call a plumber if the sink remained slow-draining and smelly; completion and outcome are not recorded.

The user had been attending yoga classes 2–3 times per week since late January 2023 and was enjoying them by 2023-05-23 and 2023-05-25. The user said yoga improved flexibility and balance and was especially interested in improving Downward-Facing Dog. On 2023-05-25, the user was looking for a mat with better grip because of sweaty hands and asked about the Manduka eKO SuperLite; no mat purchase is recorded.

The user described a 20-gallon aquarium with gouramis showing aggression during feeding on 2023-05-24. Extra food and decorations had not always worked as distractions. The user considered adding a group of lemon tetras or zebra danios and providing hiding places, but did not confirm adding fish. On 2023-05-28, the user described the aquarium as containing 10 neon tetras, 5 golden honey gouramis, one small pleco catfish, and artificial coral and rocks, and considered adding plants and a treasure-chest decoration; no additions were confirmed.

The user considered knitting a matching hat for the sweater made for the user’s sister’s birthday on 2023-05-29. The user had about half a ball of soft pastel pink merino-blend yarn left and planned to recheck its gauge. The user had recently rearranged the craft room, liked baskets or bins for yarn storage, and planned to use an existing notebook as a yarn journal. The user planned to start a new pair of socks at the weekly knitting-group meetup on 2023-06-02; completion of these plans is not recorded.

The user took a salsa class near work on 2023-05-27 and really enjoyed it; the instructor was Alex. On 2023-05-29, the user considered signing up for more classes with Alex and decided to remain in beginner classes to build a foundation. The user planned short home practice sessions focused on basics, regular practice, and slower dance videos, including DanceWithMe; no further classes or practice are confirmed.

The user’s stated music interests include indie-folk artists Bon Iver, Fleet Foxes, and Sufjan Stevens, and jazz musicians Miles Davis and John Coltrane. On 2023-05-28, the user also said they enjoyed the music-discovery podcasts “All Songs Considered” and “Pitchfork” and sought jazz-influenced indie-folk recommendations.

The user planned to analyze Instagram hashtags manually after noticing a large engagement spike after beginning to use #photographylovers on February 10 (year unspecified). On 2023-05-26, the user planned to try posting Wednesdays and Saturdays and make a content calendar featuring hashtags including #photographylovers, #travelphotography, #wanderlust, and #adventuretime. The user chose a Wednesday “Mid-Week Motivation” post with a Mark Twain travel quote and considered pairing it with a sunset photograph; publication and analysis results are not recorded.

rollups.text: The user was considering expanding a candle-and-soap product line to include room sprays on 2023-05-28. The user had scent ideas but wanted to learn about ingredients and manufacturing, then asked about regulations. The assistant supplied tutorials, suppliers, and regulatory topics to investigate; the records do not confirm that the user made or sold room sprays.

The user worked on an AWS CLI Bash script on 2023-05-20 to launch an Amazon Linux 2 EC2 instance with SSH restricted to the public IP of the machine running the script. The user then requested a 100 GB EBS volume and the instance’s public IP in the output. The resulting example attached the volume as /dev/xvdf but did not format or mount it inside the operating system; manual formatting and mounting remained necessary.
rollups.topic: EC2 launch script and storage setup
